name: Dish Deck
summary: A stack of recipe cards you swipe right to cook, left to skip and up to make tonight's dinner
about: A phone screen for planning the week's meals with six illustrated recipe cards, from biryani to kheer. The top card tilts with your finger, stamps Cook, Skip or Tonight as you drag, and flies off with a spin while the cards behind rise into place. Saved dishes fly down into a My menu tray, tonight's pick gets a gold star and confetti, and an empty deck shows a summary with Shuffle again.
how: Drag the top card right to cook it, left to skip it or up to make it tonight's dinner; a quick flick works too, and a short drag springs back.
Or press the round buttons below the deck; Undo flies the last card back in from where it left.
Keyboard: focus the deck, then Arrow Right cooks, Arrow Left skips, Arrow Up picks tonight and Backspace undoes.
Saved dishes land as chips in My menu with a counter; when the deck is empty, press Shuffle again for a new week.
